title: Time Interval
description: Reusable local civil-time fields for a containing schedule schema. Containing schemas determine whether the `opens` and `closes` pair is required; this fragment's standalone `{}` is not an interval.

opens.description: Local civil opening time in 24-hour HH:MM format, interpreted in the containing Location's `timezone`.

closes.description: Local civil closing time in 24-hour HH:MM format, interpreted in the containing Location's `timezone`.
